content: A hemoglobin A1c level of 5% (48 mmol/mol) measured in a certified laboratory is considered within the diagnostic range. A fasting plasma glucose level of 7.0 mmol/L or higher, measured after no caloric intake for at least 8 hours, is indicative of a diagnostic threshold. A 2-hour plasma glucose level of 11.1 mmol/L or higher, measured after the administration of a 75-gram oral glucose solution, meets the criteria for diagnosis. A random plasma glucose level of 11.1 mmol/L or higher, in the presence of classic symptoms of hyperglycemia, is diagnostic.
